about: Round 2, your notes applied: the wrong-clubs clip (“tee off with a putter… putting with a driver”) is gone. Now 4 bits, 40.4 s: 1) “we’re some amount of yards out… I do have eyes and I would say it’s a good distance” 2) rangefinder / “sea level water… air pressure” 3) “I don’t see a flag… shooting straight is the name of the game” 4) “no choice but to just whack it as hard as I can” → the whole shot → “shout out to that rake… straight onto the green”. On-screen text the whole way: “golf is all about confidence” (Inter Bold, lower band above your captions, never over your face). Every shot whole, swearing kept, one full-quality export from your originals. Covers: the orange-checker one was from the cut clip, so it’s gone; the other 3 stay.
